verdict.rationale: Codex has official integrations for GitHub, GitLab, Linear, and Slack to start/review work, plus a general MCP mechanism (local/remote servers, plugins) that lets it connect to third-party tools and data such as Figma or documentation sources. However, there's no explicit evidence of native or documented connectors for Jira or Google Drive specifically — those would rely on generic MCP server support rather than first-party integration. Missing for 10: explicit Jira and Google Drive integration examples, and independent confirmation these workflow-tool connections work reliably in practice.
